segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the pricing sheet for the 12 additional technician seats. With your current 42 seats, that moves you to the 50-plus tier, so the net new annual amount is $18,720, and it would co-term to June 30, 2027.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had in mind. The technicians are for the Toledo plant, and they need access before our audit prep starts on September 9.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep. If we have signature by August 16, we can start provisioning the seats the following Monday and have the admin training on August 28 or 29. Does one of those work?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: August 29 is better. Also, I need the invoice split by cost center: 70 percent Toledo maintenance, 30 percent quality.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No problem. I’ll put that on the order form and the billing tool will show two lines on the invoice. Same billing contact as last time, Maria Chen?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, Maria is still right. On terms, it’s still net 30, annual prepaid, no auto-renew change?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct. Net 30, annual prepaid, and the renewal language stays the same as your master agreement. No changes to data terms or support level.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Can you also include the sandbox access for two admins? We’ll use it for procedure testing, not production.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, two admin sandbox users are included at no charge under your plan. I’ll list them as included so procurement doesn’t think it’s a separate SKU.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the order form today if you can. I’ll route it to purchasing and aim to get you a signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over by 2 Eastern, and I’ll include the August 29 training slot and the September 9 access target in the confirmation.
